chapters.title: FIRST CONTACT
chapters.summary: A training node, a dead drop and a name that should not exist.

lines: STORY EVENT: an unregistered user left a message in your inbox.
NEW MECHANIC: LOADOUT — DECRYPT/FIREWALL/TRACE gear can now be equipped.
NEW AREA: NEXUS GRID and the outer grid are on your map.

message.text: > you opened the first door. there are more. keep reading the logs.

complete.mechanic: LOADOUT: equip gear from the market in the TRACE and FIREWALL slots.

chapters.title: THE GRID
chapters.summary: Vaults, ghosts and the first real intrusion.

lines: STORY EVENT: VECTOR joins your channel and opens the black market.
NEW MECHANIC: DECRYPT slot unlocked — cipher gear and the DECRYPTION track pay off.

message.text: Chapter two's done, {player}. Cipher Lens in your inventory — equip it in the DECRYPT slot. Don't thank me.

chapters.title: BLACKVAULT
chapters.summary: What NEXUS buries, and who it buries.

lines: STORY EVENT: Project LAZARUS is real; the fourteen are processes.
NEW MECHANIC: NETWORK slot unlocked — relay gear widens your routing budget.

message.text: You pulled the vault's teeth, kid. The deep grid will start noticing you. Gear up.

chapters.title: ZERO
chapters.summary: The core's outer ring, a missing operator and your own name.

lines: STORY EVENT: ZERO has a face. It is yours.
NEW MECHANIC: UTILITY slot unlocked — passive rig upgrades.

message.text: > half of the truth is in your hands. the other half is in the core.

chapters.title: THE ARCHITECT
chapters.summary: The leash, the list and the person who built both.

lines: STORY EVENT: the architect of NEXUS is not who you thought.
NEW AREA: AEGIS and the core approaches are open.

message.text: Chapter five. We're close now, {player}. Stay with me.

lines: STORY EVENT: the campaign ends. The network does not.
NEW: the NEXUS theme is yours.
FREE PLAY: contracts, secrets and the endless grind to NEXUS PRIME.
